data.name: Dost
data.gender_notes: Dost is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian word ‘dost’ meaning friend, companion, or ally. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ used this title for those who stood by him and supported his mission. The name Dost carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dost usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the bond of love, trust, and companionship in the divine and human relationships.
data.etymology: Dost belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dost total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
